description: Shop-level job defaults for the generate pipeline (companion to tools.json). Values here supply the top-most (job/plate) layer of the cascade: labels may still override them per label or per text line. plate_width/plate_height are the default plate size (plate layer + unbounded auto-allocation); left_clearance/top_clearance are the default plate edge clearances. Fields configured nowhere (missing here AND missing from the job spec) are required: max_h_compress, hole_margin, min_hole_margin, hole_text_collision_distance, plate_width, plate_height. Maintain one file per engraver/toolset and select it with 'plt-optimizer generate --job-config <path>'.

cutting_velocity.name: cutting velocity
cutting_velocity.description: Speed (in inches per second) at which the tool moves while cutting.

dwell_time.name: dwell time
dwell_time.description: Time (milliseconds) the tool dwells before lifting or after plunging.

plunge_velocity.name: plunge velocity
plunge_velocity.description: Speed (in inches per second) at which the tool plunges (lowers) into the material.

proximity.name: proximity
proximity.description: Proximity sensor activation (on/off). If off, the tool operates without proximity sensing and depth must be set manually before each job.

spindle.name: spindle
spindle.description: Spindle activation (on/off). Off for e.g. diamond drag engraving.

spindle_speed.name: spindle speed
spindle_speed.description: Spindle rotation speed in revolutions per minute (rpm).

vacuum.name: vacuum
vacuum.description: Vacuum (chip removal) activation (on/off). Must have vacuum connected via AUX unit for this to work.

z_clearance.name: z clearance
z_clearance.description: Controls how (in inches) high the tool lifts between cuts.

z_up_velocity.name: z up velocity
z_up_velocity.description: Speed at which the tool lifts after cutting. Specify the amount of time (in milliseconds) for the tool to go from the cutting position to the clearance height.
